Pi0.5 Export Pipeline Example#

Physical Intelligence Pi0.5 uses a three-stage Edge-LLM layout: vision, language, and action. Unlike GR00T, the action head consumes language hidden states directly (there is no separate action_context engine).

Quick start#

From the project root:

cd /path/to/Test
export EDGE_LLM_PLUGIN_SO=/path/to/libNvInfer_edgellm_plugin.so

Export and benchmark in one command:

python app.py --model pi05 --device cuda --engine-dir /tmp/pi05_edge_llm

Export and benchmark separately:

python app.py --model pi05 --export-only --device cuda --engine-dir /tmp/pi05_edge_llm
python app.py --model pi05 --benchmark-only --device cuda --engine-dir /tmp/pi05_edge_llm

Eager inference only:

python app.py --model pi05 --inference-only --device cuda

Default checkpoint: lerobot/pi05_libero. Override with --model-id.

Engine layout#

After export:

/tmp/pi05_edge_llm/
  visual/visual.engine
  language/language.engine
    config.json
    embedding.safetensors
    tokenizer artifacts
  action/action.engine

Stage parity script#

For per-module TRT compile and timing without the full orchestrator, run:

python test_vla_pi05_e2e.py

Files: trt/profile/pi05.py, trt/executor/models/pi05/export/pipeline.py, trt/executor/models/pi05/inference/pipeline.py

Edge LLM runtime#

Pi0.5 uses three engines (no action_context). Language prefill exports prefix_k / prefix_v; the action engine consumes them directly.

export EDGELLM_PLUGIN_PATH=/path/to/libNvInfer_edgellm_plugin.so

llm_inference \
  --engineDir=/tmp/pi05_edge_llm/language \
  --multimodalEngineDir=/tmp/pi05_edge_llm \
  --inputFile=/tmp/pi05_edge_llm/runtime_smoke/input_action.json \
  --outputFile=/tmp/pi05_edge_llm/runtime_smoke/output_e2e.json \
  --maxGenerateLength=0

Default export uses a static prefix of 830 tokens (3 image slots × 256 + text/state). The C++ Paligemma tokenizer may not match Python token counts for natural task strings — see End-to-End: Export and llm_inference for parity notes and smoke-test paths.

Full binding contract: Edge LLM Runtime Overview, Runners and the Request Flow, Binding Contract: config.json to GPU Memory.
